figures.caption: Figure 4: Overview of the SurFITR MLLM-powered tampering generation and verification pipeline. MLLMs are used to select forensically valuable frames from source corpora and, with assistance from grounding models, generate semantically and visually grounded tampering instructions. Localised, mask-guided manipulation is then applied, followed by verification to ensure tampering quality.
